summary.headline: Max Estates Q2 FY27 presales hit INR2,100 crores (274 units), all from sustenance sales; H1 presales ~INR3,200 crores, reported profit still small at INR4.7 crores PAT.
summary.overview: Presales were about INR2,100 crores across 274 units in Q2, with no new launch, taking H1 presales to about INR3,200 crores across 521 units. Management said Ind AS revenue recognition on handover keeps reported profit low during a strong sales, low-handover phase. Consolidated revenue was INR53 crores (+8% YoY) and PBT INR7.2 crores, with H1 consolidated revenue at INR375 crores. Management reiterated contracted revenue of INR15,700 crores with embedded PBT of INR4,800-5,700 crores, flowing from FY28, and added an MoU for 84.7 acres in West Delhi and a Ghaziabad JDA MoU for 9.7 acres.

financial_highlights.change: Q1 included half of INR from The Terraces launch; Q2 all sustenance
roughly double the same quarter last year
lower due to A&P spend of ~INR20 crores in Q2 vs INR12 crores YoY
INR950 crores is lease rental discounting
net debt ~INR200 crores; net debt/equity well below 0.5x threshold

segments.name: Residential
segments.commentary: Q2 presales INR2,100 crores from Estate 361, Max One and Estate 105; 83% of INR18,700 crores launched embedded value now sold (~INR15,700 crores). Average realisation ~INR24,700/sq ft vs ~INR18,400 in FY24.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.commentary: Max Towers, Max House and Max Square at 100% occupancy with 1.3 million sq ft leased. Max Square 2 pre-leased 3.1 lakh sq ft (~one-third of leasable area) at ~25% premium; Max District ~2 lakh sq ft pre-leased at >35% premium. Portfolio rental potential ~INR700 crores on 100% basis at stabilisation.

segments.name: Facility services (Max Asset Services)
segments.commentary: Revenue ~INR17 crores in Q2 FY27, up ~28% YoY.

guidance_outlook: Construction spend of over INR1,500 crores expected in FY27.
Operating cash flow guidance of INR750-1,000 crores for FY27, management says on track for full year; measured annually, not half-yearly.
Sector 59 (Golf Course Extension Road, Gurgaon; GDV ~INR4,000 crores; 1.3 million sq ft) on track for launch in Q3 FY27; pricing not disclosed pending final approval.
Max One commercial tower expected in FY28; Max One residential piece expected in FY30.
Estate 128 first phase delivery on track for FY28, when contracted revenue starts flowing; Max Square 2 and Max Square 6 on schedule for completion.
Commercial rental income run-rate ~INR700 crores, targeted to scale well beyond INR1,000 crores in the near term.
Business development target of 2-3 million sq ft per year; total GDV pipeline ~INR29,000 crores from Q3 FY27.
capex_capacity: Concrete poured ~60,000 cubic metres in the quarter (cumulative ~3 lakh cubic metres); steel ~7,000 metric tonnes in quarter (cumulative ~42,000).
60 floors cast in Q2, ~30% improvement over Q1.
Estate 128: terrace slabs being cast at Towers 1 and 2; Tower 3 superstructure complete; two towers completed; Phase 2 at 9th floor slab.
Estate 360: slab work reached 6th to 11th floors across 6 towers.
Delhi land (West Delhi, 84.7 acres MoU): 18-24 month approval horizon; one sector has provisional development licence; minimal cost beyond land security.
Ghaziabad JDA MoU for 9.7 acres: saleable potential 1.5 million sq ft, GDV INR2,500-3,000 crores; subject to diligence and approvals.
demand_pricing: NCR sales ~14,000 homes in Jul-Sep, flat YoY; top-7 cities sales up ~3%; NCR average prices up ~12%, highest among major cities (industry data as cited by management).
Over one-third of new NCR supply in the quarter priced above ~INR3 crores; land costs rising in development authority auctions.
Management says Max Estates volumes have grown over the last two years while market volumes stabilised.
Commercial: NCR gross leasing ~3.8 million sq ft in Q3 CY and ~10 million sq ft in first nine months; vacancy down ~200 bps YoY to ~17%; rentals up 6-10%.
Management declined to give Sector 59 pricing; an analyst cited an assumed ~INR30,000/sq ft.

qa_highlights.question: Demand outlook for NCR and Gurgaon, Sector 59 channel response, pricing upside, and launch timelines?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said NCR is stabilising in volume but Max Estates demand is robust; Sector 59 launch on track for this quarter; pricing not disclosed pending final approval; pipeline of over INR29,000 crores to be launched over coming years.

qa_highlights.question: Ghaziabad: will the company deepen presence there and what are the two Noida deals (0.5 mn sq ft under approval, 1.7 mn sq ft under auction) timelines?
qa_highlights.answer: Focus remains NCR; Ghaziabad is a first, single-project entry with a calibrated approach. Timelines for Noida deals are hard to give because they depend on government auction processes.

qa_highlights.question: Sector 59 monetisation: sell whole INR4,000 crores or phase it?
qa_highlights.answer: Too early to decide; will calibrate near and after launch in the company's best interest.

qa_highlights.question: FY29 pipeline and commercial additions?
qa_highlights.answer: Plans to add 2-3 million sq ft a year; four identified projects worth ~INR14,000 crores already acquired; commercial additions also planned, with rental run-rate ~INR700 crores targeted above INR1,000 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Delhi land timelines and costs; Max One and Sector 132 Noida details?
qa_highlights.answer: Delhi: 18-24 month timeline, no significant cost now. Max One: commercial tower FY28, residential FY30. Sector 132 auction: final approvals awaited, no leasable area or rental figures given.

risks_watch: Reported profitability remains thin until handovers; contracted INR4,800-5,700 crores embedded PBT depends on FY28 deliveries (Estate 128).
Pending approvals and government auction timelines for Noida deals, Ghaziabad MoU and West Delhi MoU; all subject to diligence.
Sector 59 launch pricing (~INR4,000 crores GDV) and absorption, given competing nearby launch.
Rising A&P spend (INR20 crores in Q2 vs INR12 crores) weighing on EBITDA.
Sustaining H2-weighted collections and FY27 OCF of INR750-1,000 crores.
Max Square 2 and Max District occupancy certificates on schedule.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand and pricing, citing Max Estates volumes growing while the market stabilised. More cautious and evasive on specifics: declined Sector 59 pricing, Noida deal timelines, Sector 132 leasable area, and Sector 59 monetisation strategy.
key_quotes: Average prices in NCR rose about 12% at the highest growth amongst the major cities.
So in a period of strong sales and low handover like the one we are in, reported profitability understates the business.
We are continuing to focus on NCR region, Karan, and we will obviously take our first stab in this market with one project.

adds.what: Sector 59 residential launch (GDV ~INR4,000 crores; 1.3 million sq ft), pending final approval
Estate 128 first phase delivery (contracted revenue starts flowing)
Max Square 2 and Max Square 6 commercial completion

growth.why: Management held FY27 construction spend above INR1,500 crores and OCF INR750-1,000 crores, with contracted revenue (INR15,700 crores embedded, PBT INR4,800-5,700 crores) flowing from FY28; Q2 revenue +8% YoY and presales ~INR2,100 crores, backed by launch timing (Sector 59 in Q3 FY27) and construction progress but no hard FY27 revenue growth number.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: H1 EBITDA only INR13.5 crores with A&P spend of ~INR20 crores in Q2 vs INR12 crores YoY, and reported profit stays thin (Q2 PAT INR4.7 crores) until FY28 handovers under Ind AS.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Estate 128 first phase delivery on track for FY28 with two towers completed and Tower 3 superstructure done, plus Max One commercial tower guided for FY28 and Max Square 2 and 6 on schedule, adding ~INR15,700 crores contracted revenue flow.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Presales ~INR2,100 crores (274 units) in Q2 and ~INR3,200 crores in H1 (~60% of FY26 presales), with Sector 59 (GDV ~INR4,000 crores) launch guided for Q3 FY27 and ~INR29,000 crores pipeline, though Q2 was all sustenance sales.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Construction spend guided above INR1,500 crores in FY27 with ~3 lakh cubic metres of concrete cumulative, and new land (West Delhi 84.7 acres MoU, Ghaziabad 9.7 acres JDA MoU, two Noida deals under approval/auction) being added, so further land and project commitments are likely.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management held FY27 construction spend (over INR1,500 crores) and OCF (INR750-1,000 crores) without raising either, and declined to give Sector 59 pricing or Noida timelines.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: OCF guidance of INR750-1,000 crores depends on H2-weighted collections (H1 collections ~INR1,100 crores), and Sector 59 pricing and absorption are undisclosed with a competing nearby launch, plus pending approvals on Noida, Ghaziabad and West Delhi deals.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Sector 59 residential launch (GDV ~INR4,000 crores, 1.3 million sq ft) is on track for Q3 FY27 pending final approval, with pricing not yet disclosed.

rows.label: Contracted revenue flow from FY28 (INR15,700 crores)
rows.why: Embedded contracted revenue of INR15,700 crores with PBT INR4,800-5,700 crores, 83% of INR18,700 crores launched embedded value sold, flows from Estate 128 delivery in FY28.

rows.label: Ghaziabad JDA and West Delhi land entry
rows.why: Ghaziabad JDA MoU for 9.7 acres (saleable 1.5 million sq ft, GDV INR2,500-3,000 crores) and West Delhi 84.7 acres MoU with 18-24 month approval horizon, both subject to diligence and approvals.

rows.label: Realisation uplift and NCR price momentum
rows.why: Average realisation ~INR24,700/sq ft vs ~INR18,400 in FY24 (+34%), and NCR average prices up ~12%, highest among major cities.

tone.note: Management was confident on demand, pricing and construction progress, but cautious and evasive on Sector 59 pricing, Noida auction timelines, Sector 132 leasable area and monetisation strategy, which analysts pressed on.
